Vulnerability Description: Default password bypass in admin login ([PURGED_INSECURE_PASS])
Root Cause: Hardcoded check for admin@getfortrip.com password in worker/index.ts

Vulnerability Description: Hardcoded default JWT & HMAC secrets in source
Root Cause: Fallback to static strings DEFAULT_JWT_SECRET & DEFAULT_HMAC_SECRET
Residual Risk / Blocker: Cloudflare Dashboard production secret rotation policy required for enterprise compliance.

Vulnerability Description: Insecure single SHA-256 with static salt for passwords
Root Cause: Weak hashing algorithm allowing fast dictionary / GPU attacks
Residual Risk / Blocker: None. All new users hashed with PBKDF2; legacy users rehashed upon login.

Vulnerability Description: Direct client /pay endpoint confirms unpaid bookings without PG receipt
Residual Risk / Blocker: Direct PG merchant contract pending (External Blocker for direct CC billing).

Vulnerability Description: Fixed test signature bypass (test_sandbox_verified_sig) and missing timestamp in postback
Root Cause: Backdoor signature check in HMAC verification
Test Result: PASS (Fake sig -> 403, replay -> 403, valid HMAC -> 200, idempotent -> 200)
Residual Risk / Blocker: None. Partner secrets verified in D1.

Vulnerability Description: IDOR in GET /api/v1/bookings allowing any user to view others' bookings
Root Cause: Missing ownership check comparing booking.user_id with auth.id
Test Result: PASS (User B -> 403 Forbidden, User A -> 200 OK)

Root Cause: Missing auth middleware and role check on admin routes
Residual Risk / Blocker: None. Admin role check and audit logging active.

Vulnerability Description: Client price tampering in POST /api/v1/bookings allowing negative amounts
Root Cause: Total price accepted directly from client JSON payload
Residual Risk / Blocker: None. Server-side price and currency validation active.

Vulnerability Description: Custom domain getfortrip.com active only on workers.dev
Root Cause: DNS CNAME and apex routing pending domain delegation
Residual Risk / Blocker: BLOCKED on registrar DNS delegation to Cloudflare.

Vulnerability Description: Empty shell page on /booking/complete without QR or receipt
Residual Risk / Blocker: None. Complete voucher with QR code and print receipt.

Desktop-first filter sidebar crowding mobile viewports

Vulnerability Description: Search autocomplete only matching 10 static cities
Test Result: PASS (25+ global IATA codes & landmark tags indexed)
